filament.name: Epic FDM PLA - Cool Detail v1

decisions: Keep the physical 0.25 mm tool-2 nozzle and existing printer preset; no printer preset is created or edited.
Preserve 220 mm/s^2 external acceleration because it is already lower than the suggested 400.
Keep 205 C normal and 230 C first layer; the previous test was already at 205 C after layer one.
Increase normal retraction only 0.1 mm, from the inherited XL 0.8 mm. Keep 35 mm/s retract speed and current pressure advance.
Use rear seam and 10% seam gap, retaining Arachne; 0.23 mm is the nominal outer-wall width, not a guarantee for every variable-width path.
Keep fixed 0.05 mm layers and upright geometry for this comparison. Adaptive layers and tilt are model/project changes, not filament preset changes.
Preserve sequential printing for spaced multi-object tests. A separate simultaneous-print experiment may give more inter-layer cooling but also adds travel/stringing.
The 20-second cooling threshold is a slowdown target, not a guaranteed dwell; minimum-speed limits can leave shorter layers.
